title: One hung mutant aborts the whole mutation run
why: hooks/mutate_guard.py run_suite lets subprocess.TimeoutExpired escape, so one hung mutant ends the run and every other mutant goes unscored.
note: Settled, no owner item: decision mutation-report-scores-suites says a timeout counts as crashed, not a kill and not a survivor. Fix: run_suite catches TimeoutExpired and records that mutant as crashed; the run goes on. Test red on main first with a mutant whose suite sleeps past the timeout.
